cards.title: About TCX Format
cards.body: TCX (Training Center XML) is Garmin's XML-based format for fitness activities. It's widely used by Garmin Connect, Wahoo, Polar, and many other fitness platforms to store workouts with GPS data, heart rate, cadence, and power metrics.

cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is an open XML standard for GPS data. It's universally supported by fitness platforms, mapping software, and navigation apps, making it the most portable format for GPS tracks.

cards.title: Why Convert TCX to GPX?
items: Import activities into platforms that don't support TCX
Share routes with users on different fitness platforms
View tracks in Google Earth, QGIS, or other mapping tools
Create backups in a universally supported format
Combine or edit tracks using GPX-compatible tools

cards.title: Compatible Platforms
cards.body: TCX files from these platforms work with this converter:
items: Any app that exports standard TCX

cards.title: What Data Is Preserved?
cards.note: Note: Heart rate, cadence, and power data are read but not included in standard GPX output as they require GPX extensions.

privacyBody: All conversion happens entirely in your browser. Your fitness data never leaves your device and is not sent to any server.
noGpsData: No GPS data found in TCX file. The file may contain only sensor data without GPS coordinates.
